name.description: Human-readable name for this alert. Defaults to 'Untitled alert' on create when omitted.

enabled.description: Whether the alert is actively being evaluated. Disabling resets the state to not_firing.

filters.description: Filter criteria — subset of LogsViewerFilters. Must contain at least one of: severityLevels (list of severity strings), serviceNames (list of service name strings), or filterGroup (property filter group object). May be empty on draft alerts (enabled=false).

threshold_count.description: Number of matching log entries that constitutes a threshold breach within the evaluation window. Defaults to 100.

threshold_operator.description:
Whether the alert fires when the count is above or below the threshold.

* `above` - Above
* `below` - Below

window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes over which log entries are counted. Allowed values: 5, 10, 15, 30, 60.

check_interval_minutes.description: How often the alert is evaluated, in minutes. Server-managed.

state.description:
Current alert state: not_firing, firing, pending_resolve, errored, or snoozed. Server-managed.

* `not_firing` - Not firing
* `firing` - Firing
* `pending_resolve` - Pending resolve
* `errored` - Errored
* `snoozed` - Snoozed
* `broken` - Broken

evaluation_periods.description: Total number of check periods in the sliding evaluation window for firing (M in N-of-M).

datapoints_to_alarm.description: How many periods within the evaluation window must breach the threshold to fire (N in N-of-M).

cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between repeated notifications after the alert fires. 0 means no cooldown.

snooze_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which the alert is snoozed. Set to null to unsnooze.

next_check_at.description: When the next evaluation is scheduled. Server-managed.

last_notified_at.description: When the last notification was sent. Server-managed.

last_checked_at.description: When the alert was last evaluated. Server-managed.

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive evaluation failures. Resets on success. Server-managed.

last_error_message.description: Error message from the most recent errored check, or null if the alert's most recent check was successful. Sourced from LogsAlertEvent without denormalization so retention-aware cleanup rules stay the only source of truth.

state_timeline.description: Continuous state intervals over the last 24h, ordered oldest-first. Each interval covers a span during which (state, enabled) was constant. Derived from LogsAlertEvent rows walked in chronological order; consecutive identical intervals are collapsed. Drives the 'Last 24h' status bar on the alert list.

destination_types.description: Notification destination types configured for this alert — e.g. 'slack', 'webhook'. Empty list means no notifications will fire. One or more destinations should be added after creating an alert.

first_enabled_at.description: When the alert was first enabled. Null means the alert is still in draft state.

updated_at.description: When the alert was last modified.
